title: presidio-hardened/evidence-ref@3
description: Cross-repo signed evidence contract, subject-binding revision (ADR-0004). Frozen with the same discipline as @1 and @2 (ADR-0001 D5). Differs from @2 in exactly two ways: each evidenceRef REQUIRES 'framework', the id of the vocabulary its item_id belongs to (one fixed vocabulary per id, never reused), and the detached signature covers the subject and the tier: alg(canonical_json({"assurance_tier": <resolved tier, 'attested' when absent>, "content_hash": ..., "framework": ..., "item_id": ..., "signer": ...})) where canonical_json sorts keys, uses (",", ":") separators, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False. A relabelled item_id, framework or assurance_tier therefore fails verification. The envelope 'schema' field is required, as in @2.

schema.description: Required; must match exactly. It selects the signed message, so verifiers never infer @3 from field presence.

assuranceTier.description: Assurance regime of the referenced evidence (ADR-0003). Optional; 'attested' when absent. Signed in @3 (resolved value).

evidenceRef.description: One subject-bound evidence reference. The 8 @1 fields and 'framework' are required; 'assurance_tier' is optional. framework, item_id and the resolved assurance_tier are inside the signed message.

framework.description: Vocabulary of item_id (for example 'iki-gov'). Signed. An id names one fixed item vocabulary and is never reused.
